text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three were evenly matched, each giving 
it their absolute all. Yet after the race, 
Copano Rickey was already setting her 
sights even higher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Copano Rickey spoke of a 
new dream that had sprouted. Rather than 
merely rivaling the others in "Four Gods 
harmony," she wanted to stand at the very 
pinnacle above them—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to rule over the "Four Gods" and 
become the reigning "Yellow Dragon." With 
renewed determination in her heart, she 
aims to become champion at the next Tokyo 
Daishoten.
